scope: Independent forward-time public BTC/USD paper comparison. No real orders, shorting or leverage. UX production code unchanged.

correction: Temporary stream backpressure now waits for drain through an ordered bounded queue. Actual I/O errors and exhausted memory allowance stop the run. Dedicated tests verify order, overflow and stream errors.

review.minor: Very large reports around 40000 quote points can exceed the renderer's spread-argument limit; outside observed 4942-point trial. Use iterative bounds before longer/high-volume trials.

limitations: Logical asynchronous lanes share one process, CPU, market feed and audit log; not process-level isolation.
The first roughly two minutes also overlapped local repository tests, so timings are not isolated CPU benchmarks.
Current fee, slippage, trade size and untuned 5s-return rule are assumptions; no general profitability claim.
